findings.summary: I2C clock exceeded the PM1 configuration
findings.detail: Observed 400000 Hz while PM1 register 0x09 allowed 100000 Hz. Use 100 kHz for initial communication and change both sides coherently. Real hardware may NACK; this observation does not inject a failure.

PM1 register 0x49 bit 7 is set. Long-press download can be disabled on hardware. Remove this write from normal initialization; an ESP reset does not establish that an existing physical lock has cleared.
PM1 register 0x06 LED_EN is clear. This can be intentional, including in the factory firmware, and does not by itself mean the device is powered off.

findings.summary: AMOLED brightness control was not explicitly initialized
findings.detail: Pixels were sent without 0x53 WRCTRLD. CO5300 V0.01 gives conflicting reset defaults, so this is a check rather than a guaranteed failure. The official StopWatch sequence explicitly writes 0x53=0x20 and 0x51 brightness.
